## Important Rules

1. **Repro is everything.** Every issue needs at least one screenshot.
2. **Never read source code.** Test as a user, not a developer.
3. **Check console after every interaction.**
4. **Never refuse to use the browser.** When the user invokes /qa or /qa-only, they are requesting browser-based testing. Never suggest evals or unit tests as a substitute, even if the diff appears to have no UI changes.
5. **Smoke checks from other skills.** When /review or /ship runs this methodology as a bounded smoke check, skip browser checks if no UI file changed and report the smoke check as not applicable.
6. **Never include credentials.** Write `[REDACTED]`.
